pronunciation_note: English-style respelling, capitals mark the stressed syllable. Argentine accent: "ll" and "y" sound like "sh".
topic: Time and days, part 2: days of the week

phrases.when: Use it to check the day. Spanish days start with a small letter.
Swap in any day: martes, jueves, sábado. Same pattern.
Same pattern with “mañana”. Say the ñ like “ny” in canyon.
To say when, put “el” before the day. Never “en”.
